description: Launch a new isolated cloud sandbox (capsule) and (by default) wait until it is ready. Returns the capsule id and connection info. Use the returned sessionId for exec/files/etc. With skill, the capsule is the skill's environment (its saved template with the software set up) and the skill's setup procedure has run, so you can use its procedures right away.

bundle.description: Software bundle (Bucket B) id to launch from

region.description: Region hint; omit for automatic placement

size.description: Resource size, e.g. '2c4g' (default, or the skill's)

skill.description: Launch a skill's environment and run its setup (a skill name from capsulate_skills)

skillVersion.description: With skill: launch this version (default the current one)

template.description: Template / OS / bundle id, e.g. 'ubuntu-22.04-headless' (not needed with skill)

name: capsulate_launch
title: Launch a capsule
